name: balloon-ledge
description: M4 Phase 3c scenario (epic #163; objects beyond the house): the balloon. Fresh boot by <FLOAD "77loadall.mud"> and <SAVE-IT> on the fixed session clock (fixed_epoch 250776000, zone UTC, microseconds 0); unmodified pinned sources, START seeds RANDOM from DSKDATE, no RANDOM override and no seed search. troll-combat's sixteen commands; `east` `south` (the studio) and `up` the chimney (CHIMNEY-FUNCTION: lamp and sword only) to the kitchen, `up` to the attic, `take rope`, back down through the trap door (it crashes shut again); the Dam Lobby for the guidebook and the matchbook; the Dome Room, `tie rope to railing`, `down` to the Torch Room, `take torch`; by the Egyptian Room `up` to the Glacier Room, `throw torch at glacier` (GLACIER, 77act1.mud:116: GLACIER-FLAG); the Ruby Room, the Lava Room, the Volcano Bottom; `open receptacle`, `put guide in receptacle`, `board basket`, `light match`, `burn guide with match` (BALLOON, 77act2.mud:419: the bag inflates, BINT queued, BRNIN queued); `look` six times (the balloon rises to VAIR1, then VAIR2); `west` onto the Narrow Ledge; `disembark`; `tie wire to hook` (WIRE-FUNCTION, 77act2.mud:585, whose PRSO/PRSI declare the undefined type PRSOBJ: BTIE, BINT disabled); `south` `north` (the Library); `untie wire` (BINT re-enabled); `board basket`; `look` (the balloon leaves the ledge); `look` `look`; `close receptacle` (the balloon descends); `look` three times ("The balloon has landed."); `disembark`; `score`. Each command was confirmed by the pinned native reference; see docs/evidence/M4/BALLOON-LEDGE-REFERENCE.md. Input ends after `score` (D3 end-of-input applies).
